benchmark: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), deterministic AST-checkable categories only (simple / multiple / parallel / parallel_multiple and live_* variants)
object: permutation of N tool-description slots in the agent tool-schema list, fixed N-tool menu, fixed task set (a pure permutation; execution-order/DAG is out of scope)
target_models: meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct (primary, subject to D16 [0.20,0.80] pilot gate)
a second tool-calling family for the H29 transfer leg
optimizer_model: gemini-2.5-flash-lite (OPRO ordering proposer, reused from Experiment T)
prior_framing: TOOL-SHADOW v1 (clawRxiv 2604.01646) argues position-induced tool-choice bias exists but supplies only a pre-validation framework and states there is no pre-registered audit; this experiment supplies the missing measurement

H27.name: Agentic ordering sensitivity
H27.prediction: For a fixed N-tool menu on the AST-checkable BFCL subset, random-ordering tool-call-accuracy std >= 0.05 (predict 0.05-0.15).
H27.falsified_if: std < 0.02 (indistinguishable from AST-grading noise) — a reportable 'tool selection is order-robust' negative

H28.name: Pre-flight forecast (7th validated live application)
H28.prediction: rho1 (swap/insert/inversion) + FDC on the tool-ordering landscape, registered to git before the main sweep, correctly forecasts whether guided/search beats random.
H28.falsified_if: the registered search-helps-vs-random-competitive forecast is contradicted by the measured search-vs-random outcome
H28.ledger_note: adds the 7th entry after J, K, M, Q2-directional, S

H29.name: Position-effect transfer across models
H29.prediction: cross-model position-rank correlation r > 0.4 (which slot the correct tool occupies transfers across >=2 model families; mirrors Q2 r=0.582 on Llama).
H29.falsified_if: the 2-model position-rank CI spans 0 (structure is model-specific)

H30.name: Multi-turn persistence (STRETCH, gated, may be dropped)
H30.prediction: if a stateful/multi-turn BFCL subset is run, ordering std >= 40% of the single-turn std.
H30.gate: runs only if Track-A resolution passes AND budget remains; exploratory not confirmatory; carries the LLM-judge/state-matching grader-noise caveat (arXiv 2607.02577)

out_of_scope.dag_execution_order: topology optimization, not a permutation — needs graph-edit-distance FDC + topology operator; future 'PRISM-DAG' extension
out_of_scope.stateful_multiturn_llm_judge_primary: grader noise (18.5% misalignment, up to 18.9pt run-to-run spread) would swamp the effect
out_of_scope.tau_bench_appworld_toolace_mcp_atlas: higher-fidelity but pricier/noisier agentic benchmarks; separate higher-budget decisions catalogued in docs/BENCHMARK_DISCOVERY_2026-07-25.md
out_of_scope.any_spend: nothing runs until Bley approves the cost cap
